C0715.title: New York Times Sues OpenAI Over Alleged Copyright Infringement in AI Training Data Scraping
C0715.summary: During a discussion on AI companies' overseas compliance, lawyers cited the case of The New York Times suing OpenAI, alleging that millions of its articles were scraped to train GPT models, infringing copyrights. The case highlights that generative AI training data primarily comes from internet databases containing original works, posing a high risk of intellectual property infringement.
